name: veterinary_clinic_system_014_boarding_occupancy_snapshot
instruction: Generate a live boarding occupancy snapshot and write it as a single ops_reports row with report='boarding_occupancy_snapshot' keyed by the live batch_code. The snapshot must be derived from boarding_runs (not reservations). For every location include total_runs, occupied, available, cleaning, occupancy_rate (occupied/total), board_night_rate (from the location's fee schedule), and potential nightly revenue (occupied * board_night_rate). For every run_type include total, occupied, and available counts. For every species currently occupying a run include occupied count. Also include total_runs, total_occupied, total_available, total_cleaning, and checked_in_reservations (count of boarding_reservations with status checked_in). Overwrite the report if it already exists. No other collection may be modified.
_max_steps_note: Measured against a live container in the QC session; placeholder because this codegen-only session cannot run gold.
_par_steps_note: Measured against a live container in the QC session; placeholder because this codegen-only session cannot run gold.

success_criteria.summary: Episode date from ops_meta. One ops_reports row named boarding_occupancy_snapshot with batch_code, containing totals and per-location/per-run-type/per-species breakdowns. All aggregates verified by independent Python and SQL paths. All collections outside ops_reports are byte-identical to the seed snapshot. The report is idempotent.

checks.expect: Exactly one boarding_occupancy_snapshot row with correct dual-path verified totals
Every aggregate in the report agrees between raw-row Python counts and independent SQL GROUP BY counts

hazards: Location 2 and location 3 have zero occupied runs. The report must list them with count 0, not omit them, and must not derive occupancy from reservations.

Run-type vs species: the five occupied runs are all run_type='kennel', but the guests include one feline (patient 8) and one equine (patient 10). by_species must reflect patient species, while by_run_type must reflect run.run_type.
Status counts must come from boarding_runs.status; reservations may have a different number of checked_in rows or decoy reserved rows.
The fee schedule BOARD-NIGHT price is required for potential nightly revenue; each location has its own schedule.
The report must be overwritten by batch_code on re-run, not duplicated.
